text:
kevin: Quick flag 1: a recent CRM sync left ~1.9k rows with owner=null and health_score=NULL. onboarding_status=imported. Need to avoid Pager noise.
alicia: Oof. Can we run a safe remediation flow? Proposal: auto-enrich low MRR, queue >$500 for manual claim, and set a transient health fallback so dashboards don't jump.
mike: +1. Also filter out any record with gdpr_opt_out or do_not_contact and any state in (archived, churned).
kevin: Here's a minimal playbook sketch for dry-run: 
```yaml
playbook: ownerless-sweep-dryrun
schedule: one-off tonight 02:30 UTC
filters:
  - owner: null
  - onboarding_status: imported
  - exclude_flags: [gdpr_opt_out, do_not_contact]
steps:
  - add_tag: { key: remediation_source, value: crm_sync_apr }
  - branch:
      condition: mrr > 500
      then: create_claim_task(queue=cs_claims_manual, dry_run=true)
      else: call enrichment_service(writeback=false, dry_run=true)
  - compute: health_score_recompute(dry_run=true)
  - set_field: { health_score_temp: 25 } if health_score IS NULL
  - notify: channel=#customer-success format=run_summary with run_id
```
ops_bot: Playbook draft created: ownerless-sweep-dryrun (sandbox). Preview: 1,920 candidates. Use `/playbook preview ownerless-sweep-dryrun` to inspect sample CSV.
alicia: For the dry-run keep writeback=false. We do not want enrichment to touch records until CS signs off. Mike, can you generate a triage CSV of MRR>500 slice (id,mrr,region,created_at,last_touch) and drop it in the shared drive?
mike: Uploaded 100-row sample: https://drive.redwood.example/samples/ownerless_mrr500_sample.csv. Also attached quick histogram: https://img.redwood.example/hist_ownerless.png
kevin: Good. Add audit tag `remediation_run:2026-05-04` and include run_id in notifications so we can roll back. Also include `skip_writeback=true` in metadata for this run.
cs_product: Suggestion: add a temporary alert-squelch rule during the dry-run window: suppress alerts for healthscore-null spikes and onboarding-missing signals between 02:00-04:00 UTC. Post the suppression start/stop in the run summary.
alicia: Agreed. We'll only flip on writeback after Monday when CS has reviewed the >$500 claims. For now schedule dry-run tonight at 02:30.
ops_bot: Job scheduled: ownerless-sweep-dryrun @2026-05-04T02:30Z. Estimated sample preview CSV attached to the job. Logs will post to #customer-success-ops.
kevin: Thanks all. Alicia, I'll pair with you on the manual triage list on Monday. If anything looks odd we'll abort the real run. :thumbsup:
